about.eyebrow: A small profile supplier, grown into a full build partner
about.headline: Building materials are the easy part.
about.sub: Hakhverdyan Shinmontazh supplies and installs aluminum, PVC, and glass systems across Yerevan — with two locations, direct European partnerships, and crews who show up when they say they will.
about.storyLead: We started as a supplier. Contractors kept asking us to finish the job — so we did.
about.storyP1: What began as profile and hardware sales grew into full installation capability because that's what the market actually needed: one team responsible for the material and the result, not two companies pointing at each other when something goes wrong.
about.storyP2: Today that means direct partnerships with Medos, dormakaba, Aluminco, Palram, and Flexidoor, warehouse capacity in Georgia to keep EU imports moving, and crews who handle everything from measurement to final fit — all from two locations in Yerevan.
about.valuesTitle: Four things we don't compromise on.
about.valuesSub: These aren't values on a wall — they're how quotes, orders, and installs actually run.
about.value1Desc: We only stock what we'd install in our own homes — sourced directly from manufacturers we've vetted, not resellers.
about.value2Desc: One quote, one price, no hidden line items. What we agree on at the start is what you're billed at the end.
about.value3Desc: Certified installation crews, not day labor. Every job is measured, engineered, and finished to the same standard.
about.value4Desc: The relationship doesn't end at handover. Technical advisory and part replacement are available long after install.
about.timelineTitle: From profile supplier to full build partner.
about.stage1Title: Started as a profile & hardware supplier
about.stage1Desc: Serving local contractors in Yerevan with aluminum and PVC profiles, sold by the meter.
about.stage2Desc: Stopped being just a supplier — started taking responsibility for the finished result, not only the material.
about.stage3Desc: Direct partnerships with Medos, dormakaba, Aluminco, Palram, and Flexidoor, with faster and more stable EU imports.
about.stage4Desc: Full-service supply, engineering, and installation — still run the same way it started: one team, one price, one result.

services.title: Not just a supplier — your build partner from spec to support.
services.sub: Three services, one team. No separate contractors to coordinate, no gaps between "we sold it" and "we installed it."
services.svc1Lead: On-site construction and structural assembly for aluminum, PVC, and glass systems — residential and commercial. Certified crews handle everything from measurement to final fit.
services.svc2Lead: Technical planning and material specification before you commit — sized, priced, and ready to build. We catch spec issues before they become expensive reorders.
services.svc3Lead: Maintenance, part replacement, and advisory support long after installation is complete. The relationship doesn't end at handover.
services.includedSub: These aren't add-ons — they're how every job runs by default.
services.inc1Desc: Priced before work starts, honored through completion — no change orders you didn't approve.
services.inc2Desc: Scheduled dates are commitments. Delays get communicated before they happen, not after.
services.inc3Desc: Every install is covered — materials, labor, and liability, from day one.
services.inc4Desc: Replacement components come from the same vetted manufacturers as the original install.
